analogy.rationale: PKC activators act through DAG-mimetic or phorbol-like mechanisms, but the annotated targets here (KCNT2, TRPV4) are ion channels poorly coupled to the canonical PKC transcriptional program in these cell lines, so responses should be weak; PKC inhibitors share the PKC node, while TRPV modulators and calcium/phospholipase activators share downstream calcium-lipid signaling.
